notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
Nmap with -sC -sV -A against port 21 runs ftp-anon (tests anonymous login, lists root if successful), ftp-syst (returns server version via STAT), and general service version detection. One command covers the key FTP enumeration checks.

=== KEY FINDINGS ===
ftp-anon: [NSE: writeable] next to files means they are world-writable — upload capability confirmed. ftp-syst: exact vsftpd/ProFTPD version for CVE lookup.

=== SCRIPT TRACE ===
--script-trace exposes raw NSOCK communication — shows every command sent/received at the protocol level. Useful for understanding what NSE scripts actually do and for debugging.
